newsitem.title: USA: Speedway says N.C.Motor panel likes its bid.
newsitem.headline: Speedway says N.C.Motor panel likes its bid.

text.p: Speedway Motorsports Inc said Monday a special committee of North Carolina Motor Speedway recommended the company's board approve Speedway's acquisition bid.
Speedway on April 16 sweetened its offer to buy private North Carolina to $32 a share in cash or stock, 39 percent more than its original bid of $23 a share in cash.
The company reiterated Monday its $32-a-share-bid is 63 percent more than the $19.61 a share Penske Motorsports Inc bid for North Carolina April 1.
Speedway said the special committee had hired a special counsel and an independent financial adviser to evaluate both bids. It has valued its offer at $71.6 million in cash.
North Carolina's board of directors must approve the bid before shareholders can vote on it, Speedway said, adding no date has been scheduled for a board meeting.
North Carolina owns a one-mile oval speedway in Rockingham, N.C., built in 1965 by a group of local investors, Speedway said.
Speedway's stock closed at 21-9/16 Monday, down 2/8.
